text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright stuck to her own-pace 
strategy. Despite a slow start, she surged 
forward in time to deliver an impressive 
finish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their strategy had paid off this time. 
However, as her Trainer, I still worried 
about whether we could keep going forward 
at her own pace like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, the Trainer suggested packing her race 
schedule to help her get used to being 
busy. However, she gently shook her head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking things slow suits me better than 
rushing around. Her resolve to win a G1 
with a relaxed approach and contribute to 
the Mejiro name was steadfast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The goal set was the GⅠ Hopeful Stakes. 
Stepping up wouldn't be easy, but the 
Trainer decided to believe in her.
